Ultralytics YOLO11n-seg
======================

Upstream authors listed in package metadata: Glenn Jocher and Jing Qiu
Upstream license: GNU Affero General Public License, version 3
Upstream source: https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics
Official checkpoint source:
https://github.com/ultralytics/assets/releases/download/v8.3.0/yolo11n-seg.pt

Local modifications: OpenScaner wraps official YOLO11n-seg CPU inference in
an isolated adapter. It verifies the official checkpoint checksum before the
pickle-capable loader, requires the exact official 80-class COCO map, accepts
only the COCO book class, and passes masks to the common quadrilateral
postprocessor. No Ultralytics source file is copied or modified here.

The verbatim upstream AGPL-3.0 license text, including its Free Software
Foundation copyright notice, is packaged at
licenses/AGPL-3.0-Ultralytics.txt. Use of Ultralytics code and trained models
requires AGPL-3.0 compliance unless covered by an Ultralytics Enterprise
License.
